title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 37
description: Ten questions on Genesis 37: Joseph's dreams, his brothers' plot and his sale into Egypt.

questions.text: How old was Joseph when he was feeding the flock with his brothers?
questions.explanation: Genesis 37:2 says Joseph was seventeen years old when he was feeding the flock with his brothers.

questions.text: What did Israel make for Joseph, the son of his old age?
questions.explanation: Israel loved Joseph more than all his children and made him a tunic of many colors.

questions.text: In Joseph's first dream, what bowed down to his sheaf?
questions.explanation: Joseph dreamed that his sheaf stood upright and his brothers' sheaves came around and bowed down to it.

questions.text: What bowed down to Joseph in his second dream?
questions.explanation: In his second dream the sun, the moon and eleven stars bowed down to Joseph.

answers.text: The sun, the moon and twelve stars
The sun, the moon and eleven stars

questions.text: Where did Joseph finally find his brothers?
questions.explanation: A man told Joseph his brothers had said "Let's go to Dothan," and Joseph went after them and found them in Dothan.

questions.text: Which brother said, "Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit"?
questions.explanation: Reuben told his brothers not to take Joseph's life but to throw him into the pit, intending to restore him to his father.

questions.text: Who suggested selling Joseph to the Ishmaelites instead of killing him?
questions.explanation: Judah asked what profit there was in killing their brother and said, "Let's sell him to the Ishmaelites."

questions.text: For how much was Joseph sold to the Ishmaelites?
questions.explanation: Joseph was drawn up out of the pit and sold to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver.

questions.text: In the blood of which animal did the brothers dip Joseph's tunic?
questions.explanation: They killed a male goat and dipped Joseph's tunic in the blood.

questions.text: To whom did the Midianites sell Joseph in Egypt?
questions.explanation: The Midianites sold Joseph into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh's, the captain of the guard.

answers.text: A priest in the land of Egypt
